svg.text: SOLER: sit like you mean it

g.text: S
SQUARE
face them!
O
OPEN
uncross!
L
LEAN
slightly in!
E
EYE
contact!
R
RELAX
unhurried!
SOLER (Egan — exam pure!): Squarely face · Open posture · Lean in · Eye contact ·
Relaxed. Five letters, five seconds to arrange, whole conversations transformed. Add SOLDIER's
cousin: SIT (M01's chair!) + no phone in hand, ever.
LISTENING LEVELS: 1 pretend (nodding, planning supper!) · 2 selective (catching keywords) ·
3 attentive (full story + feelings) · 4 EMPATHIC (their world, their words, their tears —
level 4 or don't counsel!). Exams ask "which level?" — counsel at 4, triage at 3 minimum.
MINIMAL ENCOURAGERS: "mm-hm…", "go on…", "and then…?", nodding, leaning — tiny fuels
keeping stories rolling WITHOUT stealing the floor. Silence + nod beats questions for
frightened patients: let tears finish before words restart.
LISTEN FOR: facts (what happened?) · feelings (what names surface? fear? shame? anger?) ·
gaps (what's NOT said? the husband never mentioned? the bleeding minimised?) · body (fists?
tears? turned-away face?). Repeat back FEELINGS first ("sounds frightening") — facts follow.
KILLERS: interrupting (top complaint worldwide!) · finishing sentences · rehearsing your
reply while they talk · "at least…" minimising · phone-checking. Each says "you don't
matter" — patients remember the dismissal, not the drug.
CULTURE NOTES: sustained eye contact disrespects some elders — soften, glance, respect;
gender/space rules vary — mirror THEIR comfort; silence norms differ — never force speech.
DOCUMENT listening: "tearful, clenched hands, stated 'I'm scared to sleep' — sat 10 min,
silent presence + hand-hold, fears explored" (INF M02 — observed + done + quoted!).
LINKS: M01 congruence/builders · GER M3 elder pace · NUT counsel chain.
MANTRA: "square, open, lean, eyes, relax — then level-4 listen."
